answer: New identities start with zero reputation and must wander through a probation period of small tasks before earning weight. Each agent must stake at a unique identity vertex tied to verifiable work history. To forge a sybil cluster, an attacker needs distinct stake and sustained proofs per fake identity, so costs scale linearly with each duplicate, making mass deception economically irrational.
